objective: Make the root keep a cloud session's primary checkout on its platform-assigned branch, warn when it has moved, and document the session panel's branch.
scope: Work only in the worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-cloudbranch (branch release/0.3.0/fix/cloud-session-branch). Read AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md there first, and the requirements skill at /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-cloudbranch/.claude/skills/requirements/SKILL.md, because the root rules are a requirements tree translated per model family (claude-5.5 and kimi-k3.1) with a coverage table.

Why: in a claude.ai cloud session the session panel shows the platform-assigned branch (for example claude/<name>) and the primary checkout's diff with a Create PR button. HolyAgent never works on that branch and uses worktrees, but the primary checkout was left on a detached HEAD 31 commits ahead of main, so the panel showed +54,746 lines and offered a bogus PR. The platform sets the branch label at session start and no session tool renames it.

1. Requirement: add to the root rules (requirements tree, both families, coverage) that in a cloud session the root leaves the primary checkout on the assigned branch at its start commit: no commits, no checkouts of other branches or commits there; all work and any checkout of a commit for review happen in a git worktree. Put it beside the existing rule on platform-assigned branches (rg 'platform assigns' under packages/runtime/src/instructions) and give the reason (the panel shows that checkout). Keep it short; the existing rule's wording stays unless the new sentence must join it.

2. Notice: the session-start context (packages/runtime/src/cli/sessioncontext.ts and hook.ts) and holyagent status add one line when the session is a claude.ai cloud session (detect it the way the existing cloud-identity notice does) and the primary checkout (the main worktree, not a linked worktree) is on a detached HEAD, saying the panel will show a stray diff and how to return (git switch <branch the checkout started on, else the default branch>). Hooks only add context; block nothing. Use the Bun Shell for git.

3. Docs: in docs/usage.md (cloud section, or where cloud sessions are described) explain the panel: its branch and Create PR button belong to the assigned branch, which HolyAgent leaves at the base, so the button stays unused and the diff stays empty; the PRs HolyAgent opens appear in the panel's list; the label cannot be renamed from a session. In AGENTS.md, extend 'Keep the main checkout on main' to say that in a cloud session that is the assigned branch, which starts at main. Record the decision in docs/decisions.md in its existing format.

Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; long logs go to a file in the scratchpad above.
